transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you know, Grandma's dog Pepper needs a safe place to stay during the ten-day kitchen renovation. The crew will be working in the kitchen and hallway during daytime hours, so Pepper needs somewhere else to stay. Pepper takes daily medication, needs regular walks, and is used to sleeping indoors. I'm coordinating the care plan and will make the final decision, but I'd like to go around the group first so everyone can share any thoughts or concerns before we settle on a plan. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I actually checked the medication label with Pepper's vet yesterday, and there's an important detail: Pepper needs one-half tablet with food at exactly 07:30 and 19:30 each day. Whoever takes care of Pepper will need to be able to stick to that exact schedule.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should mention something important I learned from Pepper's current sitter: Pepper becomes distressed if left alone for more than three hours. So whatever plan we come up with, we need to make sure Pepper is never left unsupervised longer than three hours at a time.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I should share something important — I spoke with Grandma before the renovation started, and she specifically asked that Pepper stay at my house rather than be moved between homes during the ten days. She was worried about Pepper being shuffled around and felt it would be best for him to stay in one place the whole time.
